qualification.normalization: each nonreference theta within 3 combined independent-evaluation and training-reference MC standard errors of unity
qualification.event_ratio: each nonreference theta RMSE <= 3 times importance-sampling mean/intercept statistical uncertainty, recorded per point
qualification.likelihood_location: all offsets within one exact local statistical sigma (Mahalanobis distance <=1), including grid discretization
qualification.likelihood_shape: each centered-surface RMSE within the exact DeltaNLL<=3 confidence region <=1 log-likelihood unit
qualification.scope: analytic architecture qualification only; full-grid profile/curvature errors also reported without post-hoc threshold changes
